title: Autumn Warrior in Retro Room
description: A woman with short black hair kneels on a cream carpet scattered with autumn leaves, wearing a blue ruffled crop top, blue shorts, blue thigh-high stockings and blue heels while holding a katana. The retro 1970s-style living room features wood paneling, a white sofa, a drum-shaped side table, and large autumn forest murals covering the walls.
prompt: A woman with short black hair kneels in the center of a 1970s retro living room decorated for autumn, wearing a blue ruffled crop top, denim shorts, blue thigh-high stockings and blue heels, gripping a katana with both hands. The room has wood panel walls, a white sofa, vintage lamp, and large detailed murals of autumn birch forests and a gothic building. Fall leaves are scattered across the black and white tiled and carpeted floor, warm cinematic lighting.
